The '''War Droids''' of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] were an archaic type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] created by the earliest members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Stationed at the ruins of the fortress [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kaleth]], the war [[Droid/Legends|droids]] proved somewhat of a mystery to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as they attacked all who entered the site.

==History==
Created by the ancient [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] known to history as the [[Weapon Master]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the formative years of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], these war droids stalk the ruins of the ancient fortress city [[Kaleth]], standing as a challenge to all who wish access to the [[First Blade]]. Created as a test of the merit of the Jedi who thought themselves worthy of wielding the weapon, the droids would attack any who approached them, including Jedi.<ref name="TOR" />

When the Jedi Order returned to Tython during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], many [[Jedi archaeologist|Jedi archaeologists]] were confused as to the purpose of the droids' unprovoked attacks. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Till'in]] led a team to the camp and planned on uncovering their purpose as well as understanding the ancient technology that kept them running for several millennia.<ref name="TOR" />
